MISSISSIPPI INFLUENZA SURVEILLANCE REPORT (MSDH)
Season: 2022-2023 | CDC Week 43 (Oct. 23 – Oct. 29, 2022)
Source: Mississippi State Dept. of Health weekly Influenza/Respiratory Surveillance Report. Provisional.

==================================================================
SUMMARY
==================================================================
During Week 43, the statewide influenza-like-illness (ILI) rate was 7.3%, which increased from the prior week (5.4%) and was higher than the same week last season (2.6%).
Also: predominant lab subtype influenza A/H1; 5 influenza/respiratory outbreak(s) reported season-to-date.

==================================================================
1. STATEWIDE ILI SURVEILLANCE
==================================================================
- State ILI rate: 7.3% (prior week 5.4%; same week last season 2.6%); trend increased.
- Sentinel reporting: 98 providers; 15044 total patients; 1101 ILI visits.
- Age groups: the percentage of reported ILI cases has been highest among those in the 5-24 years of age group.
- District ILI rates (%): I 6.2, II 17.6, III 24.4, IV 17.1, V 1.5, VI 4.4, VII 13.4, VIII 4.1, IX 5.0.
- Syndromic (BioSense): percentage of patients with a chief complaint or diagnosis of influenza-like illness during week 43 increased from the previous week, as did the statewide ILI rate.

==================================================================
2. INFLUENZA / RESPIRATORY OUTBREAKS
==================================================================
- Outbreaks reported season-to-date: 5.
- Counties: Forrest (2), Holmes (1), Lafayette (1), and Walthall (1).

==================================================================
3. LABORATORY TESTING
==================================================================
- MSDH PHL lab-confirmed influenza (since prior week): 15, influenza A/H1.

==================================================================
4. PEDIATRIC MORTALITY
==================================================================
- Mississippi: 0 influenza-associated pediatric death(s) this season.
- National: 2 influenza-associated pediatric death(s) this season.

==================================================================
5. NATIONAL ILI CONTEXT
==================================================================
- ILINet national ILI: 4.3% (baseline 2.5%).

NOTES: ILI = % of sentinel-provider visits for influenza-like illness (fever >=100F
plus cough/sore throat). All values are from the MSDH weekly report text and tables.
